name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_type_1_diabetes_mellitus_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_type_1_diabetes_mellitus_now@@diagnosed_according_to_world_health_organization_diagnostic_criteria
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus was made according to World Health Organization diagnostic criteria.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus was made according to World Health Organization diagnostic criteria.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus was not made according to World Health Organization diagnostic criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus was made according to World Health Organization diagnostic criteria.

name: patient_hemoglobin_a1c_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's hemoglobin A1c (glycated hemoglobin) measurement recorded now, in percent.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a hemoglobin A1c (glycated hemoglobin) measurement in percent is recorded now.

name: patient_alanine_aminotransferase_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_ul
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current alanine aminotransferase measurement in U/L.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a numeric alanine aminotransferase measurement (U/L) is available for the patient now.

name: patient_aspartate_aminotransferase_measurement_value_recorded_now_withunit_ul

name: upper_normal_limit_of_alanine_aminotransferase_now_withunit_ul
